title: Cosmic Paw Eclipse
description: A surreal fantasy landscape features a giant red and black cosmic orb with a prominent black paw print at its center, surrounded by smaller paw icons. In the foreground, a silhouetted figure in a hat sits on a rocky outcrop overlooking a red eclipse, flanked by a green reptilian alien with red eyes on the left, a mechanical device with a large detailed green eye on the right, and a golden alien head peering from behind the orb.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at twilight with a massive glowing red orb containing a large black paw print at center, surrounded by orbiting smaller paw prints. A silhouetted figure wearing a hat sits on a rocky cliff in the foreground. To the left a lime green reptilian alien with red eyes, to the right a complex mechanical orb with a huge realistic green iris and metallic tentacles. A golden-skinned alien with large eyes peers from behind the red orb. In the background, an ancient stone aqueduct bridge stretches across misty mountains under a starry sky with multiple moons and a red eclipse.
